entries.german: Ecclesiae herbipolensis capitulum quadringentos florenos Nicolao cardinali, archidiacono dictae ecclesiae, debitos solvit. Frater Heilmannus abbas monasterij schonaugiensis ordinis cysterciensis wormaciensis dyocesis, commissarius seu vices gerens in hac parte reuerendi in Christo patris ac dominj nostri domini Johannis episcopi wormaciensis, apostolice sedis nuncup, commissarij ab eadem sede ad infraſcripta specialiter deputati, subdeputatus, recognoscimus publice ac omnibus et singulis quorum interest uel intererit lucide patefacimus in hijs scriptis, quod nos vice loco et nomine eiusdem reuerendi patris dominj Johannis episcopi wormaciensis, commissarij principalis, necnon camere apostolice et pro ipsa camera a venerabilibus viris dominjs . . decano et capitulo ecclesie herbipolensis et ipsorum ac dicte eorum ecclesie ex parte et pro ipsis potestate nobis per eundem dominum Johannem episcopum specialiter tradita et iniuncta recepimus quadringentos florenos boni ponderis et auri in pecunia prompta et numerata nobis vice et nomine eorumdem dominorum. . decani et capituli et eorum ecclesie per strennuos armigeros Eberhardum iuniorem de Rosen-berg et Johannem iuniorem de Rosenberg preſentatos datos et assignatos ac traditos loco mediorum fructuum archidyaconatus et prebende ac eciam oblagiorum, quem quam et que reuerendissimus in Christo pater dominus Nycolaus episcopus tusculanus, sacroſancte romane ecclesie cardinalis, archidyaconus et canonicus ecclesie herbipolensis predicte, habet in eadem ecclesia, in quibus eisdem domino cardinali . . decanus et capitulum predicti racione arrendacionis per eos facte de fructibus archidyaconatus prebende et oblagiorum predictorum exſtiterant obligati, in quibus eciam quadringentis florenis loco mediorum fructuum prefatus dominus cardinalis camere apostolice predicte fore dinoscitur obligatus. Quapropter firmiter dicimus asserimus et confitemur, nos quadringentos florenos supradictos vt predicitur percepisse, et nos de eisdem florenis fore ae esse pagatos in bono pondere et auro integraliter et conplete pro reuerendiſſimo patre domino Nycolao cardinali supradicto. Vnde nos predicta potestate diximus ac fecimus ac in hiis scriptis dicimus et facimus a solucione mediorum fructuum antedictorum eundem dominum . . cardinalem, necnon dominum . . decanum et . . capitulum ecclesie herbipolensis, et dictam ecclesiam eorum de et super summa quadringentorum florenorum auri .prefatorum quitos omnino et totaliter liberos et solutos. In cuius quitacionis solucioni ac liberacionis et omnium ac singulorum premissorum robur euidens et testimonium sigillum abbacye nostre supradicte maius ex certa nostra sciencia appendi fecimus huic scripto. Actum et datum anno dominj MCCCXLVIII°, feria secunda proxima post dominicam Letare.
entries.english: The chapter of the church of Würzburg paid four hundred florins owed to Nicolaus, cardinal and archdeacon of the said church. Brother Heilmann, abbot of the monastery of Schönaug, of the Cistercian order, of the diocese of Worms, commissioner or vice-gerent in this matter of the Reverend Father in Christ and our Lord John, Bishop of Worms, appointed as commissioner by the Apostolic See, and specially deputed by the same See for the below-written matters, we publicly acknowledge and clearly make known to all and sundry whom it may concern or will concern in these writings, that we, in the place, stead, and name of the same Reverend Father Lord John, Bishop of Worms, principal commissioner, as well as of the Apostolic Chamber and for the Chamber itself, have received from the venerable Lords the Dean and Chapter of the Church of Würzburg and from them and the said church, by the power specially granted and enjoined upon us by the same Lord Bishop John, four hundred florins of good weight and gold in ready and counted money, in our place and in the name of the same Lords the Dean and Chapter and their church, presented, given, assigned, and handed over by the valiant knights Eberhard the younger of Rosenberg and John the younger of Rosenberg, for the income of the archdeaconry and prebend, and also for the oblations, which and whatever the most Reverend Father in Christ Lord Nicholas, Bishop of Tusculum, cardinal of the Holy Roman Church, archdeacon and canon of the aforesaid church of Würzburg, holds in the same church, for which the same Lord Cardinal, the aforesaid Dean and Chapter were obligated by reason of the lease made by them from the fruits of the archdeaconry, prebend, and oblations aforesaid, in which also four hundred florins the aforesaid Lord Cardinal is known to have been obligated to the aforesaid Apostolic Chamber in place of the interim fruits. Therefore, we firmly state, assert, and confess that we have received the four hundred florins as stated above, and that we are fully and completely paid for the same florins in good weight and gold on behalf of the most Reverend Father Lord Nicholas, the aforesaid Cardinal. Hence, by the aforesaid power, we have said and done, and in these writings we say and do, that the same Lord Cardinal, and the Lord Dean and Chapter of the Church of Würzburg, and their said church, are entirely and completely free and absolved from the payment of the aforesaid interim fruits concerning and above the sum of four hundred florins of gold aforesaid. In witness and testimony of this acquittance, payment, and release from all and every of the premises, we have, with our certain knowledge, affixed the greater seal of our aforesaid abbey to this document. Done and given in the year of the Lord 1368, on the second ferial day next after Dominica Laetare.
